help: Sets a colony's size directly, up to 15 (Console Commands' own setmarketsize stops at 10). Updates the population condition, the Arcology World, Ecumenopolis or Hyper-Ecumenopolis stage and the planet's look. Past 10 the colony needs an Omega core administrator first. Uses the colony you are docked at if no name is given.
Sets how far a colony has grown towards its next size, in percent. 99 makes it grow within days, if it is allowed to grow.
Shows a colony's size, size limit, growth, administrator, stage and AoTD scaling.
